name: Chamber Materials

pages.title: What to bring home
pages.text:
A Trial Chamber supplies all four materials this mod runs on.

- **Breeze Rods** drop from Breezes.
- **Breeze Shards** are in supply chests and corridor pots.
- **Breeze Crystals** come from ordinary vaults.
- **Heavy Cores** come from ominous vaults.

pages.title: Breeze Shard
pages.text:
The workhorse. Shards repair both the detector and the goggles, 250 durability at a time in an anvil at a flat cost that never rises, so you will keep needing them long after the first raid.  
Expect roughly eight to eleven from a full chamber.

pages.title: Breeze Crystals
pages.text:
The lens material. Two of them make one pair of goggles and that is the only thing they are for, so a single chamber is enough.  
Vaults, and the handful of hidden chests that share a vault's loot. Breezes never drop them.

pages.title: Heavy Core
pages.text: Vanilla's own ominous vault drop, and the hard gate on this mod. The detector takes **two**, so a detector is a real expedition rather than an afternoon.

description: The four things a raid is for.
